commits.headline: build(compiler): add the opt-in -frac2-wide-saves-below switch
commits.author: bigbeno37
commits.body:
Without -mastra-quad-saves every GPR save slot is 8 bytes, but save_restore_insns saves a
register in the widest mode the function writes it in, so stock cc1 saves a TImode-held
$sN with sq into an 8-byte slot, where it overwrites the neighbouring save. With
-frac2-wide-saves-below such a save takes a 16-byte slot at the bottom of the GPR save
area, the other GPRs keep 8-byte slots above it in register order, and compute_frame_size
adds 8 bytes per wide save. It keys on the save's mode, never…

write_dependence_p makes every store through $v0 depend on the prologue's $sp saves. An
unseeded hard register ($v1, say) takes…

commits.author: bigbeno37

combinable_i3pat moves the SUBREG to the source and folds K through gen_lowpart_common. The result
is a li.s hoisted to the block start, or sched1 splits the SUBREG store into hi/ior and f sits in
a saved GPR with an mtc1…

commits.headline: docs(compiler): record the per-unit loop threshold flags for patch 0055
commits.author: bigbeno37
commits.body:
Patch 0055 keeps the second hi/lo pair fixed, which lowers loop.c's hoisting threshold
from 64 to 61 in every unit. A unit whose loops need retail's 64 can opt back with
-fcall-used-hi1 -fcall-used-lo1 -fcall-used-accum1 (measured for func_0026EDE8: it needs
64 <= T < 67; with 61 it is 0 of 1). Applied everywhere the flags change 6 of 160 sampled
matched units, so they stay per unit. Decided by the lead maintainer on 2026-11-07.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
